theme: Three days of returning to the present — practicing the most important skill

days.task: Sit in complete silence for 10 minutes. Just observe what arises — without judgment. Write what you found.
Choose one activity today and do it with full presence — no multitasking, no phone. Write which activity and what you noticed.
Every time your mind wanders today, simply notice and return to the present — without judgment. Count the returns.
